services.name: crowdsec
services.description: CrowdSec behavioral IDS/IPS engine — DORMANT placeholder (Cloudflare-off fallback). Container runs but detects/remediates nothing: empty acquisition, online API (CAPI) disabled, no bouncers wired.

services.name: introspect-proxy
services.description: OIDC token introspection sidecar for Caddy Bearer auth

services.name: mcp-oauth
services.description: MCP OAuth 2.1 authorization server for mcp.diegonmarcos.com (option 31.1, WIP, NOT approved): RFC 8414/9728 discovery, RFC 7591 DCR, /authorize behind Authelia, PKCE S256 /token, opaque tokens introspected by introspect-proxy

services.name: tokens-api
services.description: Fleet token engine: lists, generates, reveals and revokes every fleet bearer token (fleet ft_ tokens and adopted Authelia JWTs); introspect-proxy asks it before accepting a Bearer, so a revoked token stops working within 60 seconds. Public address: c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/tokens-api (shared gate, #1104); mesh tokens-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com

services.name: caddy
services.description: Caddy reverse proxy + security dashboard (gcp-proxy, wg0 bind)

services.name: caddy-public
services.description: Caddy public-edge L7 allowlist on oci-analytics. Terminates TLS on :8443, serves ONLY the declared-public allowlist (build-caddy-public.json: gh-pages, no-auth subdomains, well-known, explicit public_paths), and FORWARDS everything else to the private hub gcp-proxy over wg-public (10.1.0.2:443). Fail-closed: any host/path not explicitly allowlisted is forwarded to gcp-proxy, whose @wg gate 403s public clients.

services.name: wireguard-mesh
services.description: Read-only data-driven control panel for the WireGuard mesh + wstunnel TCP/443 fallback. Mimics Headscale's UI shape but holds zero state and exposes zero mutations — pure observability over the existing declarative VPN data (cloud-data-topology.json + bb-net_vpn/build.json + terraform.json). Snapshot is frozen at deploy time; the page hydrates from PORTAL_DATA, no runtime fetch.

services.name: wireguard-mesh-ws-tunnel
services.description: WireGuard-over-TCP/443 fallback for hostile networks (airport / hotel / corporate guest Wi-Fi blocking UDP). Sibling to bb-net_wireguard-mesh (the panel) — this folder owns the wstunnel-server that terminates WSS on gcp-proxy and forwards UDP to the kernel WG listener at 127.0.0.1:51820. UDP/51820 remains the primary transport; this kicks in only when clients can't reach UDP.

services.name: wireguard-public
services.description: Owner of the wg-public mesh topology + client list. Data-only entry (enabled=false → no container/compose). Replaces the previous wireguard_public block that lived in config.json (root global), so adding/rotating/sharing a wg-public client is a one-file edit here instead of touching the global config.

public_allowlist._doc: THE fleet public-route allowlist. Every route is WG-only fail-closed (wgOnly(proxy) = proxy.wg_only ?? true, off-mesh -> 403) unless its service is listed here. Public means: some proxy block in build.json sets wg_only:false. Memory: cloud-me-my-ai 4___ASSETS___/4.3.Memory/cloud-u-containers/infra-sec_caddy/project_wg-only-fleet-posture.md (+ feedback_cloudflare_wildcard_only.md). Guard: _shared/test-public-route-allowlist.mjs.

Listed so the guard passes on current main without hiding them; each needs an owner decision (move to WG-only, or promote to allowed with a reason). Owner decision 2026-10-16 + item 5 (MCP auth discovery): a claude.ai MCP connector completes the OAuth sign-in BEFORE it holds a token -- discovery metadata (RFC 9728 / RFC 8414, incl. per-resource variants), Dynamic Client Registration (/register), /authorize, /token and the callback. The tool endpoints (/<route>/mcp) stay Bearer-protected; a request to any of these paths is answered by the MCP side itself.

Owner decision 2026-10-16: the wstunnel client opens a WebSocket upgrade to a secret path prefix and cannot do a cookie/bearer handshake. The exemption is `Upgrade: websocket` only; wstunnel itself rejects every upgrade whose path is not its secret --http-upgrade-path-prefix, and every non-upgrade request to vpn. is gated.

technical.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-16: ACME http-01 validation requests come from the CA and cannot carry a token. Exempted on EVERY host (the path is excluded from the gate). Caddy core answers a live token before any route runs; this fleet itself issues via DNS-01.

Browsers never attach credentials to a CORS preflight. The (edge_auth) snippet answers it itself with 204; it is never proxied to an upstream, so it serves no content. Plain OPTIONS (WebDAV discovery) is NOT exempt.
IMAPS / SMTPS are not HTTP: caddy-l4 forwards the raw TLS stream to Stalwart, which authenticates the mail login itself. There is no HTTP request to carry a bearer or cookie.
